sections.content: Indexes are sorted lookup structures (B-trees) that turn full table scans into fast seeks — huge wins on large tables for WHERE/JOIN/ORDER BY columns.
Costs: every INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE maintains indexes (write slowdown + storage). Create them on columns you filter/join/sort by, not speculatively everywhere.
Key points: composite indexes follow leftmost-prefix rule, covering indexes include all queried columns, and EXPLAIN shows whether indexes are used.

sections.codeExample:
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
-- speeds up: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?
